newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIAN PESO CLOSES DOWN AT 1,120.35 VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIAN PESO CLOSES DOWN AT 1,120.35 VS DOLLAR.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed down 1.35 pesos against the dollar at 1,120.35, amid heavy demand for greenbacks from the food and electricity-generating industries, interbank dealers said.
Dealers said high dollar demand from banks and industry combined with limited influxes of petrodollars and coffee export earnings pushed the peso downward and could do the same in trading Wednesday.
Dealers reported 443 trades worth $217 million, above the daily average of about $180 million. The peso opened at its intraday high of 1,119 and fell as low as 1,121.85 before closing.
